 
By adding at the end of the resolution clause after the word 
“shortage” the following: “, and the Minister to report back to the 
House on a potential wage solution by the end of the year 2018”.  
 
Mr. Speaker put the question on the proposed sub -amendment and 
it was defeated on the following recorded division:
